title: Responsible technology assessment (FIT5205 A4)
scale_note: The rubric gives criterion weights only; levels use bands of 85-100%, 70-85%, 50-70%, 25-50%, 0-25% of the weight.

criteria.name: Research, analysis, writing quality and referencing

levels.label: Very good
levels.description: Insightful, critical, draws on diverse, high-quality sources; flawless language and APA referencing.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Logical, well-supported with appropriate sources; minor language or citation issues.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Adequate research and reasoning; occasional writing or referencing lapses.

levels.label: Needs improvement
levels.description: Limited research; writing errors hinder clarity; referencing patchy.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Minimal research; disorganised writing; serious referencing faults.

criteria.name: Clarity and coherence of scenario description

levels.label: Very good
levels.description: Comprehensive, perceptive portrayal of scenario and stakeholders.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Clear description covering most relevant aspects.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Covers main points with some omissions.

levels.label: Needs improvement
levels.description: Partial, missing several key details.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Incomplete or inaccurate scenario outline.

criteria.name: Ethical design analysis using Beard & Longstaff

levels.label: Very good
levels.description: Sophisticated application of all principles with nuanced insight.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Detailed, accurate analysis of most principles.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Acceptable coverage with occasional misinterpretation.

levels.label: Needs improvement
levels.description: Limited, superficial or partially incorrect discussion.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Absent or largely incorrect analysis.

criteria.name: Human rights analysis using AHRC framework

levels.label: Very good
levels.description: Demonstrates superior understanding; explains rights implications cogently.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Solid grasp; explains key rights issues clearly.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Adequate identification and explanation of rights.

levels.label: Needs improvement
levels.description: Partial or shallow treatment of rights.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Little or no evidence of understanding rights issues.

levels.label: Very good
levels.description: Perceptive critique; imaginative, actionable recommendations.

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Competent analysis; relevant, feasible recommendations.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.description: Reasonable analysis; recommendations mostly sensible.

levels.label: Needs improvement
levels.description: Narrow analysis; recommendations limited or vague.

levels.label: Unsatisfactory
levels.description: Weak or missing analysis; recommendations absent or irrelevant.
